integrity: All-order proof uses a noncrossing-forest extension argument and reversible rooted-face decomposition. The finite standalone checker verifies forests/series for n=3..12 and all 549 diagonal-support traces for n=3..6. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: The result applies to true diagonal queries on straight-line trees of strictly convex labeled polygons; it does not extend as stated to all-edge queries, forbidden boundary edges, nonconvex configurations, or online dimension. Bibliographic priority beyond inspected material is not guaranteed. The dual-path triangulation count was known previously from two-ear enumeration.
title: Diagonal-query shattering of noncrossing spanning trees and a polygon-dissection enumerator
